fact: On 4-6 November 2024 Niger's territorial administration director general said registers for taxpayers, voters, State salaried staff, social insurance, pensioners, scholarship students and the unified social register could be set up on the new identification system.
title: Atelier du projet WURI Niger : Le projet restitue les travaux d'enregistrement de 3000 personnes dans les communes de Tagazar, Dogondoutchi, Mayahi et Tanout
